Group and automerge non-major devDependency updates
Do not automerge the Stryker Bun runner, because Koja patches it, Bun only warns when the patch no longer matches, and an unpatched runner fails the mutation dry run. See scripts/mutation-tuning.md.
prBodyNotes: Koja patches this runner, so the patch must be carried forward:
1. In `package.json`, rename the `patchedDependencies` key and its path value to the new version.
2. Rename the patch file under `patches/` to the same version.
